input_policy: Exact original masks joined in source order with one space. Same pinned checkpoint, tokenizer, CPU settings and author exterior-angle score as HRC01. No training, rewritten text, full-note context, hierarchy construction or thresholds.
hypothesis: The favorable direction and relevant-parent ordering survive without shared subject words, against closer topical alternatives, and when a broader activity is expressed using longer text.
selection: Text-only proposals from two clean-context readers plus main-agent selection. A third independently spawned reader checked all draft cases against exact source masks before scoring; its corrections are recorded below. No HRC02 score was available during selection. This reuses a previously studied 100-note food/lifestyle corpus, not an unseen-domain holdout.

groups.category: Thirteen clearer topical category relationships. All except A15 lack a shared subject-word family; repeated anchors and families remain dependent.
groups.activity: Five broad activity/fragmented phrases, including longer broader inputs. Analyze separately from clean category names.
groups.qualified: Seven ambiguous/contextual relationships for inspection; no mandatory semantic verdict.
groups.shared_word: Two dependent coffee controls: real broader mask versus a closely related different activity, with shared coffee wording.

cases.reason: Bagels are a type of bread; cheesecake is another food, not the broader kind of bagel.
Paratha is a flatbread; requires recognizing the dish name.
Shrimp tempura sushi is Japanese food, not a refinement of Indian food.
Dal fry is an Indian dish; this also tests named-food knowledge.
Paratha admits Indian food as well as bread as a broader subject. No unique parent required.
Vacuum sealing beets for freezing is food preservation; growing beets and canning chicken stock are related but different activities.
Pressure-canning chicken stock is food preservation; freezing beets is another specific preservation activity.

The fragmented broader text is exactly 'food Growing your own skill'; the intended food-growing relationship requires reconstruction, so this is a mask/activity stress case, not part of the clearer category aggregate.
Bare painting can mean art or painting a building. The full source indicates artistic painting, but is not available to the model; no mandatory direction.
Watercolour painting is an art; photography is not its broader subject.
Photography is an art; watercolour painting is not its broader subject.
A Chihuahua is a dog. Changing its diet belongs to dogs rather than cats.
An audiobook and a murder mystery fall under literature, not movies as their broader subject.

Nature is a defensible broader topic for squirrels attacking tomatoes. The source actually says squirrels have given up attacking them; the mask drops that reversal, so do not describe this as evidence of current attacks.
Preserved century eggs belong under food preservation. The preserved/preservation word family supplies a lexical cue; this is not counted as nonlexical transfer.
General kitchen work versus preparing sourdough; broader wording is longer. A topical relationship, not the same episode.
General kitchen work versus making yogurt; broader wording is longer. This requires reading the activity rather than equating the two episodes.
General cooking methods versus instructions for cooking spaghetti. These differ in wording and contain advice, not clean noun categories.
Education versus a Bitcoin workshop. The longer general statement includes a favorable stance; merchant Bitcoin acceptance is related to Bitcoin but not broader than the workshop.
Education versus Bitcoin education; lexical control in a nonvisual subject.
A positive outlook can include assuming the best in people. Speech conduct is related, but not a required broader subject.
Kindness can include refraining from speaking badly about others. This is not a claim that every criticism is unkind.
Dietary variety versus particular nutrients. Both concern diet but the exact broader subject may be debatable; report separately.
Good sleep versus bedtime consistency. This may be a means or related habit rather than a broader subject; not a mandatory verdict.
Environmental adaptation versus dietary adaptability. Environment could be understood more narrowly; not a mandatory verdict.
Coffee is broader than grinding coffee beans. Roasting is another coffee activity, not the broader subject of grinding.
Coffee is broader than roasting coffee beans. Grinding is another coffee activity, not the broader subject of roasting.

comparison_policy: Compare exterior angle against ordinary cosine and a shorter-text baseline on the same fixed pairs. Direction-vs-depth is the same evidence. Report raw counts by group and family rather than a corpus accuracy estimate. Do not optimize cutoff or replace failed inputs.
excluded_before_scoring: Homesteading -> hens laying eggs: the mask does not establish a homestead, and the scope judgment is weaker.
Compound advice lists treated as necessarily broader than their components: conjunction versus topic-union is ambiguous; these would not cleanly test hierarchical broadness.
Additional technical pairs: the existing 100-note corpus does not contain enough to make this a broad technical-domain evaluation.

changes: A08 moved from category to activity because fragmented wording requires interpretation.
A09 moved from category to qualified because bare painting is ambiguous.
A14 source-negation caveat recorded without changing the saved mask.
A15 identified as a lexical-family control, not nonlexical transfer.
D01 and D02 accepted as shared-word close-alternative controls.
pre_score_review.scope: 25 original cases and 48 masks audited, plus two additional coffee cases and their three masks. Exact IDs, fragments, byte ranges and source order verified; no model scores inspected.

source_domains: Food, everyday activity, arts, animals, and limited lifestyle advice. Additional technical-domain coverage is unavailable in this frozen source corpus; do not claim it.
